q2_separately_pinned_native_owner_runtim.missing: Broker-owned pinned owner root and broker-executed owner call.

q3_request_receipt_channel_with_external.observed: HMAC harness attestation and signed grants exist; R09 trust root is caller-constructed; child authors the observation.
q3_request_receipt_channel_with_external.missing: Declarative broker request protocol, broker-authored signed receipt, externally pinned issuer admission.

missing_primitive.name: separately protected native-owner execution broker
requirements: candidate cannot read/write broker code, receipt ledger or issuer key; same-UID process access excluded
separately pinned approved owner code and exact inputs resolved by the broker
validated declarative operation requests; no candidate-supplied call names/code/digests/results
broker captures its own return object and emits an issuer-authenticated receipt
verifier pins issuer identity/public key and checks owner code/input/policy/K/run/nonce/sequence and real consumer ref
atomic nonce/cold replay and typed malformed-input refusal preserved
missing_primitive.non_claim: Broker execution proves broker invocation, not arbitrary internal candidate calls. A stronger observation claim would require a separately qualified runtime/instrumentation mechanism.

competent_owner: host/platform administrator for disposable VM or dedicated non-admin service UID, ownership/ACLs, process isolation and local socket
R09/CI engineering for broker protocol, pinned owner loader, receipt/ledger and verifier
repository administrator for pinned owner code root and any separately granted protected-CI integration
minimum_permission: host administrator authorization to create one disposable environment (macOS VM preferred; alternatively one dedicated non-admin r61-broker UID on a disposable host) with two principals
repository administrator authorization to place approved owner code at a read-only non-candidate-writable pinned path
authority to create an Ed25519 receipt key in the broker/issuer domain and pin its public key in the verifier
no production credentials, provider changes, live worker dispatch or protected-CI deployment

smallest_disposable_qualification.environment: one disposable sourcefree VM or host with candidate principal and broker principal
smallest_disposable_qualification.broker_root: /opt/r61-broker owned by broker, 0700; owner snapshot read-only 0500; issuer.key 0600; ledger 0600; Unix socket 0660 with peer-UID check
required_cases: positive C11 ingest/repository with independently computed expected result
wrong nonce/sequence and cold replay refused
D7 malformed typed input refused without crash
consumer assertion mutation fails; restoration re-passes
smallest_disposable_qualification.acceptance: Only exact broker receipts for exact requests are accepted; candidate cannot author observations or obtain signing material; no arbitrary-internal-call claim.
